external_entities.name: readers
external_entities.description: People who access the public site and fetch content from the web server and CDN.
external_entities.source_excerpt: readers hit the web server over HTTPS

external_entities.name: admin
external_entities.description: A person who maintains the database directly rather than through the CMS.
external_entities.source_excerpt: There is an admin who maintains the database directly rather than through the CMS.

external_entities.name: CDN
external_entities.description: The CDN from which readers fetch images, stylesheets and downloads, and whose bucket receives newly published assets.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Readers fetch those from the CDN over HTTP.

processes.name: web server
processes.description: The public web server that serves the site, runs the CMS, accesses the MySQL database and pushes new assets to the CDN's bucket.
processes.source_excerpt: The web server runs the CMS

processes.name: CMS
processes.description: The CMS running on the web server.
processes.source_excerpt: The web server runs the CMS

data_stores.name: MySQL database
data_stores.description: The database on the same hosted network as the web server that keeps pages, accounts and comments.
data_stores.source_excerpt: keeps pages, accounts and comments in a MySQL database
data_stores.notes: The source says: "I could not tell you whether the database is encrypted on disk."

data_stores.name: CDN's bucket
data_stores.description: The CDN bucket to which the web server pushes newly published assets.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the web server pushes them up to the CDN's bucket

data_flows.name: site requests
data_flows.description: Readers access site content from the web server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: readers hit the web server over HTTPS

data_flows.name: asset fetches
data_flows.description: Readers fetch images, stylesheets and downloads from the CDN.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Readers fetch those from the CDN over HTTP.

data_flows.name: CMS database access
data_flows.description: The web server running the CMS keeps pages, accounts and comments in the MySQL database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The web server runs the CMS and keeps pages, accounts and comments in a MySQL database

data_flows.name: asset push
data_flows.description: The web server pushes newly published assets to the CDN's bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When new assets are published the web server pushes them up to the CDN's bucket.
data_flows.notes: The source says: "Nothing here tells you how the push to the CDN is authenticated."

data_flows.name: direct maintenance
data_flows.description: The admin maintains the MySQL database directly rather than through the CMS.
data_flows.source_excerpt: There is an admin who maintains the database directly rather than through the CMS.
data_flows.notes: The connection is described as unsecured and there is no jump host.

trust_boundaries.name: public
trust_boundaries.description: The public network location from which readers access the public site and the admin connects from wherever they happen to be.

trust_boundaries.name: hosted network
trust_boundaries.description: The hosted network containing the web server and MySQL database.

trust_boundaries.name: CDN
trust_boundaries.description: The separate zone containing the CDN and its bucket.

assumptions.basis: The source calls it the public site and says readers hit the web server.

assumptions.assumption: The MySQL database's contents are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The database contains accounts and comments, in addition to pages; accounts may contain credentials and the records are not described as public.

assumptions.assumption: The CDN bucket's contents are public.
assumptions.basis: Readers fetch the published images, stylesheets and downloads from the CDN.

assumptions.assumption: The public and hosted-network zones are distinct network locations.
assumptions.basis: Readers access the public site from outside the hosted network, while the web server and database are explicitly on the same hosted network.

assumptions.assumption: The CDN is controlled as a separate tenant zone.
assumptions.basis: The CDN and its bucket are described as a separate service from the web server and hosted network.
